about_the_game:
CUE SPORTS: REDEFINED

Feel the peak of cue sports in Pure Pool Pro, sequel to the acclaimed Pure Pool. Delivering hyper-realistic physics, pinpoint-precise controls, and stunning native 8K visuals on supported platforms, Pure Pool Pro raises the bar with refined AI opponents, competitive online play, local play, and new immersive playing environments designed for both newcomers and seasoned pros.

MASTER EVERY MODE & BUILD YOUR CAREER

Compete across a variety of modes:

  • Career Mode: Progress through hundreds of events across 8-Ball and 9-Ball careers at Amateur, Focused, and Pro difficulty.

  • Games & Challenges: Test your skills in mini-games like Speed Pot, Checkpoint, Accumulator, Perfect Potter and Royal Rumble.

  • Daily Clearance: Build your streak by completing a daily challenge; earn the ultimate bragging rights!

  • Leaderboards: Climb global rankings and unlock exclusive rewards to cement your status as a cue sports legend.

  • Local Play: Take on friends at home with local multiplayer in a variety of game types.




ONLINE, CROSS-PLAY, AND LOCAL MULTIPLAYER

Jump into seamless multiplayer with full cross-play support to prove your skills against other Pure Pool Pros worldwide. Add players to a dedicated friends list via friend code, then challenge them in intense private matches. Friends offline? Download their “DNA” player profile to practice against them while they’re away, or invite them over to battle it out in local play.

IMMERSIVE POOL VENUES

Bring your A-game to two distinct new pool venues: the futuristic Tetradome, a 1,000-seat arena built for high-stakes competition, and the Rackhaus, a cosy pool hall nestled at the top of a luxury skyscraper, designed for more intimate matches. Each venue offers a unique atmosphere that captures the thrill and intensity of professional pool.

20 UNIQUE PURE POOL PROS TO DEFEAT

Face off against 20 uniquely skilled AI opponents, each designed with their own personality, strategy, and signature cue. Smarter, more reactive AI players adapt to your style and ramp up the pressure, offering dynamic and challenging matches that mirror real-world competition.



CUTTING-EDGE VISUALS & SLEEK INTERFACE

Experience breathtaking visuals with lifelike lighting and stunning ray-traced reflections. From the nap of the baize to imperfections in the cueball, every shot feels alive. A modern, streamlined interface with intuitive menus and smooth navigation means less waiting and more play.

CUSTOMISATION & UNLOCKS

Personalise your experience with a wide range of unlockable cues, cue balls, ball sets, and baize designs. Earn unique profile crests through flawless frames and jaw-dropping trick shots to showcase your skill and stand out in the online community.

MASSIVE SOUNDTRACK

Over 80 songs spanning genres from laid-back jazz - echoing the fan-favourite music from the first game - to high-energy tracks that rise to match the excitement of high-stakes play.

—

***COMING Q1 2026 - WISHLIST NOW***
A new era of Pure Pool - ready for the Pros. Add it to your wishlist and be among the first to experience the future of cue sports simulation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5-7400 / AMD FX-8350 (quad-core or better)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (4GB) / AMD RX 570 (4GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X (6 core or better)
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 (8–12 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: This is cue sports: redefined. Master 8-Ball, 9-Ball and more in solo, local or online with crossplay. Tackle a huge pool career mode, with 8K visuals, immersive venues, lifelike physics, precise controls and deep customisation, delivering the definitive pool sim experience.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
